title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Training Note: Reconnect Fee History and Restore Cushion Days
content:
**Rule.** For the restore payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the underlying service account was billed two or more reconnect fees in the twenty-four-month window, the cushion days are increased by 2; where it was billed exactly one, they are increased by 1; with none they are not increased for reconnections.

The reconnect fees are those billed on the underlying service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

### Questions answered

**One reconnect fee billed twenty-three months ago.** Within the twenty-four-month window and exactly one: increased by 1.

**Three reconnect fees in the last year.** Two or more: increased by 2.

**A reconnect fee on another of the member's service accounts.** Not counted; the rule reads the underlying service account of this enrollment.

**The only reconnect fee was billed twenty-five months ago.** Outside the window: not increased for reconnections.
